name: Lord
description: Slang for a creature that boosts other creatures sharing a creature type; also a retired creature type for high-ranking creatures.

timeline.summary: The Lord creature type is retired with Tenth Edition after lengthy debate.
timeline.quote: The creature type Lord was retired with the printing of Tenth Edition .

citation.text: "Lord", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brady Dommermuth decides to eliminate the Lord type, counting on players using Lord as slang.
timeline.quote: I'm intending to go with the "cut the Gordian knot" option: eliminate the Lord type.
